suppressants.title: Which agents were tested on which fuels
suppressants.blurb: Each tag is an investigation that used the gas on that kind of fuel. Only two investigations tested a gas as an extinguishing agent; the rest used it to dilute the flame.

coolFlame.title: Out is not always out
coolFlame.blurb: What a fire can do after it appears to go out: the hot, visible flame ends, but low-temperature burning carries on as a cool flame.
coolFlame.caption: ILLUSTRATIVE SKETCH, NOT MEASURED DATA. NO TEMPERATURES OR TIMES ARE PLOTTED.
coolFlame.alt: Sketch of flame temperature over time. A hot visible flame burns steadily, then drops sharply when the visible flame goes out. Instead of falling to zero it settles at a low level, a cool flame, which continues through the period when the fire looks extinguished. It then either persists or quenches, depending on small residual airflows.
